name: Wrestling Figurative
overview: The biblical concept of wrestling figuratively represents intense spiritual and relational struggle, as seen in Genesis where Rachel speaks of wrestling with her sister and Jacob wrestles with a mysterious man until daybreak, resulting in a lasting physical mark. This imagery highlights perseverance and confrontation with powerful forces beyond human strength. Ephesians expands this understanding by clarifying that believers' true struggle is not against flesh and blood but against spiritual forces of darkness, emphasizing the ongoing, unseen battle in the Christian life.
